finance.eyebrow: LOANS AND SUPPORT FOR YOUR BUSINESS
finance.title: Possible government support
finance.intro: These are possible matches to help you plan. They are not government eligibility or loan approval.
finance.lenderIntro: These published lender products may also fit. Final terms come from the lender.

calculator.title: Check your monthly payment
calculator.intro: Enter a lender's rate or use this example rate for planning.
calculator.amount: How much do you want to borrow?
calculator.needInfo: Add monthly sales and expenses to check this.
calculator.comfortableText: This payment is within 20% of the money left after expenses.
calculator.cautionText: This payment uses 20–35% of the money left after expenses. Keep a bigger emergency reserve.
calculator.tooHighText: This payment is more than 35% of the money left after expenses, or no money is left.
calculator.guideline: These are simple UdyamSathi planning guidelines, not a bank decision.
calculator.invalid: Please enter a valid loan amount, interest rate and loan period.
calculator.estimateOnly: UdyamSathi gives an estimate to help you plan. The final amount, rate and approval are decided by the lender or scheme.

pmmy.description: Business loan support for small shops, repair work, tailoring and other small enterprises.
pmmy.bestFor: Small shops, tailoring, repair, services and other micro businesses.
benefits: For stock, equipment or day-to-day business needs.
No collateral is required under the scheme.
need: Simple business details and bank details
Any extra document the lender asks for
steps: Choose a lender offering MUDRA loans.
Ask which MUDRA category fits your amount.
Submit your details and read the final lender terms.

pm-svanidhi.description: Small working-money support for street vendors to buy stock and continue their business.
pm-svanidhi.bestFor: Street vendors, hawkers and small mobile sellers.
benefits: Small loans in steps after regular repayment.
Interest subsidy may be available under current rules.
need: Vendor document or Letter of Recommendation
steps: Check your vendor document with the local body.
Apply through the official portal or participating lender.

stand-up-india.description: Bank loans for eligible entrepreneurs starting a new business.
stand-up-india.bestFor: Eligible SC/ST and women entrepreneurs starting a new business.
benefits: Published range of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for eligible greenfield businesses.
steps: Contact a participating bank for its final decision.

maharashtra-msme-support.description: Find current Maharashtra Government MSME support, training and service information.
maharashtra-msme-support.bestFor: Entrepreneurs in Maharashtra who want verified state support information.
benefits: Find current official support and service information.
need: Requirements depend on the programme you choose.
steps: Open the official Maharashtra MSME support site.
Check rules with the official office or District Industries Centre.
